Literal reduction gives injective N-torsion specialization into the prescribed elliptic curve; source and target torsion counts prove surjectivity and an actual cyclic-subgroup bijection. The actual good-model discriminant proves the positive-order divisibilities six and four and the order-versus-stabilizer dichotomy. Finite torsion fields, good models, specialization places, residue-field identification, faithfulness, equivariance, torsion lifting, subgroup transport and the stated order bounds are derived, not supplied as certificates.
